readers._note: HOW TO READ A ROUTE'S FILES AT POINTS, for Sample satellite files at points. Paths and attributes read from the files themselves on 2026-11-05 (experiment 179: S5, S6 and the sampler's structure probe), not from documentation. A route with no entry here has no reader yet, and the widget says so rather than guessing.

quality.note: The product readme says above 0.75; the product user manual's table, greater than or equal to 0.75 (S8). The two differ only at exactly 0.75. qa_value is stored as an integer with scale_factor 0.01, so the comparison is made on the stored integer: the scale factor is stored in 32 bits as 0.0099999998, so 75 times it is 0.74999998, which a comparison on the scaled value would wrongly fail.

MODIS documents its QC bits and recommends no rule (experiment 180, M1). Bits 0-1: 00 produced, good quality; 01 produced, other quality; 10 not produced, cloud; 11 not produced, other. Bits 6-7: average LST error <= 1, 2, 3 or > 3 K. Clear_sky_days and Clear_sky_nights are one bit per day of the eight (M2).
